name: Fable's merge, run skillmove_run1 (the final selection of run t1)
rule: for every tensor (same 883 names in both checkpoints): DELTA = bf16(float32(SOURCE) - float32(BASE)); MERGED = bf16(float32(BASE) + scale * float32(DELTA))

scales.in words: the MLPs of the first 17 layers, copied whole
all attention projections and q/k norms, the MLPs of layers 17 to 33, all layer norms, the tied embedding and the final norm: half of MedGemma's change

note_on_copied_whole: scale 1.0 through the bf16 DELTA is how the scored checkpoint was built; build.py prints how many entries of these tensors differ from MedGemma's own (bf16 rounding of DELTA and of the sum)

check.digest_definition: sha256 of the lines '<tensor name> <sha256 of the tensor's raw bf16 bytes>\n' over the tensor names in sorted order
